ruling.recommended_action: Refund $4.17 (RydeTAXI meter excess attributable to the unexempted off-route segment) as a voucher within the 30-day window; log the driver's RD-1 shortest-route breach; no account flag on the driver (route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 before this case)

segment_findings.reason: Driver proposed the Bedok South Avenue 3 diversion at 23:03 [F7] before the segment began at 23:06 [F3], and the rider himself answered "Sure, go ahead." at 23:03 [F8]. RD-5 consent is satisfied (rider's own timestamped message, pre-departure). The route change is therefore exempt under RD-5/RD-4; the RD-4 traffic justification is unverified (F13, band 4 in F11/F12) but is moot given consent.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's 'rider agreed' claim is not the ground for the exemption — it merely corroborates the chat. The consent relied on is the rider's own pre-departure message [F8] (RD-5, G11).

AIRPORT BOULEVARD band 4 (30–39 km/h) is not an incident on the optimal route [F13] and is far outside bands 1–2; RD-4(b) band facts cannot exempt a segment on their own, and the exempted road here was East Coast Parkway anyway.
